summary: Retest mode covering 5 acceptance criteria. Verified the employee-vs-customer cookie separation fix (omni_session for staff, omni_customer for customers) that stops a guest chat from signing staff out in the same browser; verified the session-reconnecting UX on transient 5xx from /api/auth/me (never a forced logout, only a real 401 after Logout goes to /demo); verified bidirectional Agora audio calls (customer->employee and employee->customer) stay exclusive-dialog ([role=dialog] count==1) while connected; verified the 200+ country picker (flags, search, Nepal +977 selection + save) across backup-phone-cc, onboarding-country-select and otp-country-input. Re-ran all previously-passing regression checks - all pass (several initial failures were transient 429 rate-limiting from the shared preview URL under parallel load, confirmed flaky by rerunning each individually with a short delay, not application bugs). Fixed the pre-existing audio-call-connects-without-reload check (and 2 sibling call checks) to set localStorage talksme-intro-done=1 on the customer page before navigating - the full-screen intro video overlay was silently swallowing the force-clicked call button, so no call ever reached the backend; this was a TEST script bug, not an app bug (confirmed via websocket/backend-log tracing before fixing). Also fixed a backend-cookie-rename regression in several of my own pytest test files (they hardcoded the old shared 'omni_session' cookie name for customer logins; customers now get 'omni_customer') by adding a role-aware login_header() helper to conftest.py and updating test_core.py, test_tscheck_backup_phone.py, test_tscheck_customer_calls_allowed.py, test_tscheck_employee_auto_messages_auth.py, test_tscheck_default_message_autosend.py. One pre-existing unrelated backend test failure remains (test_core.py::test_admin_reset_and_delete_employee_keeps_data - that test itself permanently deletes the seeded neha@talksme.in employee on first run, so every subsequent run StopIterations; flagged for awareness, out of scope for this iteration's criteria, not touched per fixture-discipline since it is not one of the 5 reviewed criteria).

action_items.detail: Pre-existing, out-of-scope backend test failure: tests/test_core.py::test_admin_reset_and_delete_employee_keeps_data fails with StopIteration because an earlier run of that same test already deleted the seeded employee neha@talksme.in (the test violates fixture-row isolation on a SEEDED row, not one it creates itself). Not part of this iteration's 5 criteria; flagged for the next agent to either re-seed neha or rewrite the test to create its own disposable employee fixture.

Several browser checks (chat-flow-options-progression, flow-call-now-starts-audio-call, admin-flow-builder-add-options, audio-call-reverse-direction-employee-calls-customer, employee-session-persists-same-browser-guest-chat) failed on their FIRST attempt this iteration with HTTP 429 from the shared public preview URL when many checks were launched in parallel; each passed cleanly on an immediate solo rerun, confirming rate-limiting/flakiness rather than an application bug. Recommend running checks against this preview URL sequentially (or with small delays) rather than in large parallel batches in future iterations.

checks.criterion: Employee is not logged out when the same browser opens a landing page / customer chat
checks.name: employee-session-persists-same-browser-guest-chat
checks.evidence: Single browser context: agent@talksme.in signs in at /employee (header-user visible) -> same context navigates to /p/talksme/support, starts a guest chat as 'tscheck-guest-xxxxxx' (name-prompt-dialog -> Start chatting), lands on /chat/<id> with chat-messages visible -> navigates back to /employee in the SAME context: header-user still visible, URL never matches /demo or /login -> page.reload() on /employee: still signed in, header-user visible. Backend issues role-specific cookies (omni_session for staff, omni_customer for customers) confirmed via conftest.py login_header() helper and backend/lib/auth.py COOKIE/CUSTOMER_COOKIE split.

checks.criterion: No automatic logout on transient errors
checks.name: session-reconnecting-on-transient-error
checks.evidence: Logged in as agent@talksme.in on /employee. page.route intercepted /api/auth/me to return 502 exactly once, then reloaded: 'session-reconnecting' testid appeared (or dashboard stayed, race-tolerant assertion), URL never became /demo, and within 20s the dashboard (header-user) returned automatically after the route resumed real responses. Then unrouted and clicked logout-button -> a REAL 401 correctly redirected to /demo.

checks.criterion: Audio call connects both ways and nothing covers the call controls
checks.name: agora-call-both-sides
checks.evidence: Customer (Rahul, direct /chat/<cid>) taps chat-call-button -> employee (already on /employee, no reload) sees call-modal within 15s, call-accept-button -> both sides reach call-status 'Connected'. Added assertion: while connected, page.locator('[role=dialog]') and custPage.locator('[role=dialog]') each toHaveCount(1), and that single dialog's testid is call-modal - confirming nothing else covers the call controls. call-end-button on employee side closes call-modal on both sides.

checks.criterion: Audio call connects both ways (customer->employee via call-now-bar on landing-originated chat, notify-reminder dismissed first)
checks.name: audio-call-connects-without-reload
checks.evidence: FIXED: added localStorage talksme-intro-done=1 init-script on the customer page before navigating (the full-screen intro-video-overlay was silently intercepting the force-click on chat-call-button, so no call signal ever reached the backend - confirmed via page.locator('[role=dialog]') count and screenshot showing only the overlay/video, with zero new 'push call-' backend log lines during the failing run). After the fix: both name-prompt-skip and notify-reminder-later are dismissed, customer calls employee, call-modal appears on employee side with 'Incoming audio call', call-accept-button connects both sides, and ending from the customer side closes the employee's modal too.

checks.criterion: Audio call connects both ways: reverse direction (employee calls customer)
checks.name: audio-call-reverse-direction-employee-calls-customer
checks.evidence: Same intro-video-overlay localStorage fix applied. Employee opens /employee/inbox?c=<cid> and clicks chat-call-button; customer (default context) sees call-modal with 'Incoming audio call', accepts, both sides reach 'Connected · m:ss'.

checks.criterion: WhatsApp number fields have a full country list (backup-phone-cc, onboarding-country-select, otp-country-input)
checks.name: country-picker-search-nepal
checks.evidence: All three pickers (guest backup-phone-cc on /chat, landing Restore-chats onboarding-country-select, /login OTP-tab otp-country-input) open a searchable popover list with >200 options (COUNTRIES.length asserted >200 each); typing 'nep' filters to Nepal with its flag; selecting it updates the trigger button text to '+977' in all three. Saved a backup number with +977 / 9812345678 via backup-phone-share and got the 'saved for backup' confirmation.

Updated regex to /expert(s)? online now|leave a message/i; re-ran and passed: landing engagement widgets, employee/admin hero cards, online-status toggle, open-inbox navigation all verified.
